title: Saving a reply for later
odia: ଏ କଥା ରହିଲା ମନେ, ବେଳ କାଳ ଦେଖି କହିବି ଦିନେ
literal_meaning: I will keep this in mind; one day I will speak when the time is right.
explanation: The speaker declines an immediate reply while making clear that the matter is not forgotten. Depending on the situation, the line can sound restrained, pointed or quietly threatening. It preserves a future opportunity to answer rather than offering reconciliation now.
meaning_odia: ଏବେ ଚୁପ୍ ରହିଲେ ମଧ୍ୟ କଥାଟି ମନେ ରଖି ସୁଯୋଗ ବେଳେ ଉତ୍ତର ଦେବା।
usage_example: Someone is dismissed during a meeting and replies that they will return to the matter when the facts can be discussed. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The time and occasion remain unspecified in the wording. This entry explains its possible conversational tone without assigning it a historical dispute.
